name: JSON Diff
tagline: Paste two JSON documents, see the difference. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Paste the old document on the left and the new one on the right. Added bits light up green, removed bits red, and changed bits show both. Nothing is sent anywhere — there is no account, and the text never leaves this device.

The last pair you pasted comes back the next time you open the app. Press Invite in the GifOS bar to show the same difference, read-only, for everyone in a meeting. They can look; they do not type over it.

An unofficial port of jsondiffpatch by benjamine. Same visual difference the original demo draws, plus the JSON delta and JSON Patch. List items that carry an id are matched by that id, not only by position.
